experience.blurb: Option Circle — automated trading bot for options traders. I work on the engine underneath it.

roles.title: Automated Trading Bot
roles.blurb: A trading automation product for options traders: strategies are configured in the UI, then executed, monitored, and exited by the backend without a human in the loop. My work is the engine — the part that has to be right every tick.

contributions.text: Built the dynamic trailing stop-loss engine in Redis Lua (EVAL/EVALSHA): atomic per-tick read–modify–write cycles track peak profit and derive dynamic exit thresholds, so concurrent market ticks can never race on shared position state.

Implemented profit-trigger activation with trailing state persisted in Redis — staged entries and partial exits driven off the same atomic state, so a position scales in and unwinds in steps without inconsistent intermediate states.
Published close events over Redis Pub/Sub to separate exit detection from order-closing execution, so execution latency never blocks evaluation of the next tick.

Debug live order-execution, market-data, and position-management flows across distributed microservices; evaluated migrating the pipeline from Polygon WebSocket → Kafka → Telegraf → InfluxDB onto Redis Streams with a Go-based Telegraf bridge to cut infrastructure complexity.

roles.title: Schema & AI Layer
roles.blurb: The translation layer between what a trader configures and what the engine executes — plus the first AI surfaces in the product.

contributions.text: Engineered a high-performance conversion service (Java 11, Spring Boot) translating complex UI workflows into the canonical schemas the execution engine consumes.

Architected a dynamic schema-mapping pipeline on LuaJ, executing 2,700+ lines of Lua transformation scripts for payload generation — mapping logic ships as scripts instead of requiring a backend recompile.
Authored 900+ lines of Java validation logic enforcing data-integrity constraints to reach functional parity with UI-level validation.
Integrated the Gemini API through Spring WebFlux clients for volatility agents — engineered the prompt workflow and parsed structured output into typed decisions behind technical gating.

projects.name: TickPulse
projects.summary: Market alert and trailing-stop engine. Live crypto ticks from the Binance WebSocket land in Redis Streams, get evaluated atomically by Lua, and fan out to clients over Server-Sent Events.
projects.impact: At-least-once delivery via consumer groups, XACK acknowledgment, and pending-list recovery on restart; alert history persisted in PostgreSQL behind validated REST APIs with Actuator health and metrics; the full trailing-stop state machine verified end-to-end with Testcontainers.

projects.name: Cooked
projects.summary: Backend aggregation service pulling user data from Spotify, GitHub, and Reddit over OAuth 2.0, then generating structured personas through an engineered prompt workflow.
projects.impact: Three third-party APIs behind one REST surface with rate-limit safeguards and hardened error handling; LLM output parsed deterministically into a typed persona schema rather than free text.
